dw_footprints.use: Wet Footprints: the nightmare's wet dragging trail, two ragged smears with a cold wet shine (frames alternate down the path); fade them with alpha over PRINT_SECONDS. Anchor = the route point.

dw_mud.use: Mudflats: a wet mud patch on each mud step, a small puddle eye in it (frame 1 a bubble instead); pick by route index; on the ground under the water's damp band. Anchor = the route point.

dw_reeds.use: Reed Bed: a reed clump standing in the carried water, a cattail on the tallest, swaying (stands on the bank: y-sort it, or draw it over the water). Anchor = its foot at the water line.

dw_still_sheen.use: Still Water: the water goes mirror-still and a pale crescent moon shows in it, wavering a little (on the water surface, one every few steps). Anchor = the route point.

dw_wave_flash.use: Breaking Wave / Flash Flood: a wave that rises, curls a white lip and breaks into foam and spray, then fades (one shot, ~0.43 s). Flip it when the wave runs right to left. Anchor = the water's middle.

kt_allegro_note.use: Allegro: a kept Toll, two beamed quick notes in bronze with a motion streak, circling the bell (up to 3). Anchor = between the note heads.

kt_bronze_prime.use: Down the Line / Both Ways: a primed nightmare's mark, a small bronze bell lit from the upper left, its clapper swinging (over its pips). Its ring arcs can use the same ramp: Oak, Ember, Gold. Anchor = the bell's lip.

kt_humming_pip.use: Humming Walls: the pip a wall filled, a thorn-wrapped bead in Thornwall colours with hum arcs pulsing outward. Anchor = centre.

lf_constellation_pip.use: Constellation: one small warm star per different Warden counted (and the star's charges). Draw faint dotted Gold lines (alpha 0.4) from each pip to the star so it reads as a star chart. Anchor = centre.

lf_constellation_star.use: Constellation: the star lit over a nightmare, warm (Heartlight core, Glow and Gold rays, a banded halo). Anchor = centre.

lf_full_glow_ring.use: Full Glow: eight firefly motes circling a lit nightmare's feet in a faint pool of light (on the ground, under it). Anchor = centre.

lf_moth_flame.use: Moth to Flame: the kept crit, a tall flame with a moth circling and dipping to it (LanternMark; was circles at (10, -32)). Anchor = the flame's foot.

lf_moth_flame_ready.use: Moth to Flame, ready (its 4 hits are in): the flame burns hotter with a denser halo and the moth's wings catch fire. Same frames and anchor as lf_moth_flame.

lf_pale_path_dot.use: Sightline: a warm eye-shaped gleam on each pale-path step that blinks slowly (on the ground). Anchor = the step's centre.

lf_strung_pip.use: Strung Lights: one fairy-light bulb per glow entered, hung 6 px apart: their strings join into one line. Anchor = the string at the bulb's top.

lf_waiting_flame.use: Bonfire: a little bonfire, a two-tongued flame on crossed sticks, over a nightmare holding a waiting crit (LanternMark; was two circles at (-10, -30)). Anchor = the sticks' foot.

sp_cap_badge.use: Host Trees: the cap a Warden of another family wears. Frame 0 its own cap (Blossom), frame 1 a passed-on cap (Spreading Caps: pale). Anchor = the stem's foot, on the Warden's head.

sp_fed_ground.use: Feeding Ground: a fed patch on each route point, pink spore dust settling and two curled shoots swaying; fade it with alpha as its 8 s run out. Anchor = the route point.

sp_rot_ring.use: Rot Ground: a rotten ring on a Sprout bed's step, fallen grey cap stubs on it and a pink spore wisp rising (on the ground). Anchor = the step's route point.

sp_throne_rim.use: Toadstool Throne: a mushroom throne, a broad cap seat with a tall cap backrest and gold trim and crown studs, drawn under the clump (before the mushroom sheet; the clump stands in front of the backrest). Anchor = the clump's foot.
